top_news.title: Recognition, Simulation, and Refusal: A Contamination-Aware Study of Classic Psychological Effects in LLM Agents
top_news.dek: PsyAgentBench separates LLM mimicry from genuine psychological bias using a factorial design.
top_news.brief: Researchers introduced PsyAgentBench to distinguish between an LLM's ability to simulate human psychological response patterns and its actual possession of those biases. By testing models with both labeled and blind prompts, as well as canonical and counterfactual scenarios, the study aims to isolate lexical contamination from true behavioral traits.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the factorial design of PsyAgentBench

top_news.title: Claude Status – Elevated errors for multiple models
top_news.dek: Anthropic has resolved an incident causing elevated error rates across several Claude models.
top_news.brief: Anthropic reported a period of elevated error rates affecting Claude Fable 5, 5.1, Mythos 5, 5.1, and Opus 5. The issue, which began on September 22, 2026, was fully resolved after approximately 80 minutes of impact. Success rates have returned to normal levels.

top_news.title: Muse, Meta's extraordinarily privileged AI assistant, has a serious 0-day
top_news.dek: A zero-day vulnerability in Meta's Muse agent allows unauthorized control via local apps.
top_news.brief: Meta's new AI assistant, Muse, is reportedly vulnerable to a zero-day exploit that grants local applications and terminal commands full control over the agent. Despite claims of being built for security, the flaw allows attackers to bypass intended protections, raising significant concerns regarding the agent's privileged access.
top_news.image_alt: Security warning icon over a stylized AI interface

top_news.title: NVIDIA Introduces SoL-Pi: Auto-Research Loops That Cut Coding Agent Token Traffic by Up to 49%
top_news.dek: NVIDIA's SoL-Pi mechanisms reduce coding agent token traffic by nearly 50%.
top_news.brief: Researchers from NVIDIA, NTU, and MIT released SoL-Pi, a set of four efficiency mechanisms for the Pi coding agent. Discovered via AI-driven auto-research loops, these optimizations reduce token traffic by up to 49% and API costs by 33% on the EdgeBench evaluation, while maintaining 94% of the original model's performance.
top_news.image_alt: Chart comparing token usage between Pi and SoL-Pi

top_news.title: [AINews] Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro 1T-A42B: the new top Open Weights model, trained for $3M
top_news.dek: Xiaomi released MiMo-V2.6-Pro, a natively omnimodal open-weights model trained for $3M.
top_news.brief: Xiaomi has entered the frontier lab space with its MiMo-V2.6 series, featuring natively omnimodal capabilities. The release includes the Pro model for high performance, a Flash version for efficiency, and an UltraSpeed variant designed for high-throughput generation, marking a significant milestone for the company's AI development.
